_readme: Per-club content for the sign-off page. Authored by the League, kept in the
repo so every flag is reviewable in a diff rather than typed into a database.
note   one or two sentences at the top saying what this club needs to do.
Club-specific — not a generic preamble. Inline HTML allowed.
fixed  things we corrected on their behalf. Shown in green so the club can
catch us if we got one wrong. Tidying only — de-duplication is not
listed, that was the form being used twice and is nobody's business.
check  the things we still need an answer on, keyed to where they appear.
Anchored per role, so a media question never appears under someone's
apply  the machine-readable form of `fixed` — the edits actually made to the
record before it is rendered. Keep the two in step: anything claimed in
`fixed` must have a matching entry here, or the page contradicts itself.

Gateshead.note: Thanks for getting this over. Your entry is in good shape — four small things below and we're done.

check.info:capacity: We hold 11,800 on file against the 9,800 submitted here. Which is right, and how much of that is seated?
check.people:Jon Goodwin:Media & marketing: We'll show Head of Media here unless you tell us otherwise. You cover both commercial and media, and we'd rather each role carried its own title than repeat one across both.
check.people:Simon Johnson:Team operations: This role came through without a title. We'd rather not guess — what would you like shown?
check.people:Mike Coulson:Club secretary: Your details are marked not for publication. As we'd normally publish a club secretary contact, we'll include them here unless you'd rather we didn't — just say and we'll keep them off entirely.

Carlisle United.note: Thanks for this — a thorough submission. We've tidied a couple of small things ourselves (listed below) and there are three where we need you.
fixed: Frazer Bell's job title read Head of Sports Science and edical. We've made that Medical.
Lucy Weston's number was entered as 0330 0945930 Opt 1. We've moved the menu option into the extension field so the number dials on its own.

check.list:dlo: We don't hold contact details for Teressa Mulholland. As your nominated disability liaison officer it'd be useful to have a direct route — could you send an email address or phone number?
check.list:plo: Likewise for Jonny Sunley, your police liaison officer.
check.people:James Tose:Community: Could we take contact details for the Community Sports Trust? We don't currently hold an email address or telephone number.

roleTitle.to: Head of Sports Science and Medical
